text: Deel, Inc. is a privately held US (Delaware/San Francisco) global payroll and EOR company; it is venture-backed with a $300m Series E at a $17.3bn valuation co-led by Ribbit Capital and Andreessen Horowitz, and has no sovereign or state shareholder on its cap table.

source.name: Deel official blog 'Our Series E: Building the global infrastructure of work'; FinTech Global coverage
source.quote: We're thrilled to welcome Ribbit Capital as a new investor, co-leading this round alongside our long-time partners Andreessen Horowitz and Coatue Management.
